about_short_description.short_description: Vizly is a AI-powered data scientist that enables chat-based interaction and analysis, facilitating immediate insights from uploaded data.

product.name: AI-Powered Data Analysis
product.description: Vizly offers AI-driven data analysis, allowing users to upload data files, ask questions in natural language, and receive insights through generated Python or R code.

product.name: Data Visualization
product.description: Vizly provides tools for creating quick data visualizations, including bar charts, pie charts, line charts, and more, to help users understand their data better.

product.name: Machine Learning
product.description: Vizly supports machine learning capabilities, enabling users to clean data, train models, and predict future trends based on their datasets.

product.name: Private Code Sandbox
product.description: Vizly includes a private code sandbox for users to experiment with data analysis and coding in a secure environment.

product.name: Google Sheets Integration
product.description: Vizly integrates with Google Sheets, allowing users to analyze and visualize their spreadsheet data with AI-driven insights.

product.name: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
product.description: Vizly streamlines the EDA process, offering automated suggestions and visualizations to help users explore and understand their data.
